summary: Initializes a 45-entry global table centered on dword_8AF8F8. Each entry (5 dwords, 20 bytes) is reset: the two dwords before the entry center are zeroed and set to -1, the entry itself is set to -1 with the following dword -1 and the 9th byte zeroed. Each iteration calls StringCopyWithBufferRealloc(byte_5EA438) and discards its return value.

operations.description: Point v0 at the global table base dword_8AF8F8.
Seed loop counter v1 = 45 (table entry count).
do-while loop running 45 iterations, advancing v0 by 5 dwords (20 bytes) per iteration.
Zero the dword at v0 - 2 (two dwords before the entry center).
Set the dword at v0 - 1 to -1.
Call StringCopyWithBufferRealloc(byte_5EA438) each iteration; the returned buffer pointer is not stored.
Set the entry center dword *v0 to -1.
Set the following dword v0[1] to -1.
Zero the byte at v0 + 8 (9th byte of the 20-byte entry).
Return the result of the last StringCopyWithBufferRealloc call.

unresolved: The table spans addresses before dword_8AF8F8 (writes at v0 - 2 and v0 - 1 reach 0x8AF8F8 - 8 and - 4); the table's start and its semantic meaning are unknown.
Purpose of the discarded StringCopyWithBufferRealloc return value per entry is unknown.
Structure of the 5-dword entry (which fields are -1 sentinels vs. pointers) is not evidenced.
